sourceTitle: The Spanish Cavalier: A Story of Seville
description: "The Spanish Cavalier: A Story of Seville" by A. L. O. E. is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. Set against the backdrop of Seville, the narrative follows the lives of Don Alcala de Aguilera and Lucius Lepine, two young men from different backgrounds who navigate the complexities of pride, honor, and personal sacrifice.
